items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: Yeah, I stayed with Ambie. No, I stayed with Ambie about three years.

ctx.x: I don't know what dance hall he was at. But he was at one. But Octave Crosby told me that Danny Barco would come back home because he used to play this with me. Right here, taxi dance.
How long were you with Ambie?
Well I stayed with Ambie a long time.
